documents.title: Versioning overview
documents.guidanceExcerpt: Every api-version uses a unique `YYYY-MM-DD` date and versions are declared in strictly increasing chronological order from top to bottom of the `Versions` enum.
documents.applicableGuidance: Versions are chronological and preview changes are explicitly scoped.
documents.evidence: The new stable version follows the existing version sequence.

documents.title: Evolving APIs
documents.guidanceExcerpt: You can add new models, properties, or operations in a specific version and all subsequent versions using the `@added` decorator.
documents.applicableGuidance: New versions declare dependencies and use versioning decorators to control version-specific shapes.
documents.evidence: Preview-only recovery shapes remain scoped out of the new stable version.
